headline: Aflac (NYSE:AFL) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q2 CY2026 Earnings
summary: Supplemental insurance provider Aflac (NYSE:AFL) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales falling 9.2% year on year to $4.12 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.75 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
